title: Space profile titles and descriptions carried no locality, so a Space page could not answer a <type> in <city> query

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, seo-local finder). lib/spaces/profile-metadata.ts titled the root profile with the brand name alone and described it as '<name>: a <type> on Frequency', while spaces.city was read only for the LocalBusiness addressLocality. Local search and answer engines rank on the locality in the title and description, the way every local listing carries it. CLOSED 2026-10-05: the root title is '<name>, a <type> in <city>' and the description says 'in <city>' when the Space has one; sub-tabs keep the short title (the tab label fills it). check:seo polices double-branding, not length, and the root template still appends the site name once.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("lib/spaces/profile-metadata.ts","utf8");if(!/const rootTitle = city \? `\$\{brandName\}, \$\{typePhrase\(space\.type\)\}\$\{where\}` : brandName/.test(s)||!/\$\{typePhrase\(space\.type\)\}\$\{where\} on \$\{SITE_NAME\}/.test(s)){console.error("SCAN-665: the Space profile title and description carry no locality, so a Space page cannot answer a <type> in <city> query and reads like a brand page, not a local listing.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
